gap_this_closes: the reading rule said 'observed >> shifted reference' without defining >>. If a result of, say, the 96.8th percentile arrived, deciding then whether that is '>>' or 'ordinary' would leave the rule formally frozen and the classification post-hoc anyway.

gate_B_has_no_pass_fail.rule: gate B is assigned NO PASS/FAIL semantics
gate_B_has_no_pass_fail.only: a pre-defined DESCRIPTIVE PLACEMENT of the observed value within the registered shifted-lattice reference
gate_B_has_no_pass_fail.narrows: GANN_INFERENCE_AMENDMENT_V1 registered a gate-B threshold (Z_phi0 > p95(maxZ_shift)). This artifact does not change any computation — it narrows what may be CONCLUDED from it to descriptive placement.
gate_B_has_no_pass_fail.runner_note: gann_historical.py is already running and will write a gate_B.result PASS/FAIL field from that threshold. That field is a raw threshold comparison, NOT a verdict, and this classification does not endorse it as one.

report_fields: observed percentile / rank among the 999 + observed

explicitly_not: 'p < .001' — > max shifted means only that the observed geometry fell outside the whole range of 999 registered shifted lattices

CASE 2 — ORDINARY WITHIN REFERENCE.interpretation: shifted lattices readily reproduce the observed scale; a Gann-specific explanation is not needed

CASE 2B — TAIL / INDETERMINATE.interpretation: unusually high relative to the shifted reference, but not clearly outside the registered placebo family

CASE 3 — MIXED ACROSS CLAIMS.condition: different claims land in different categories
CASE 3 — MIXED ACROSS CLAIMS.interpretation: claim-level reading ONLY; no family-wide story

p95_is_not_a_threshold: p95 here is a descriptive reference-bin boundary, not a significance threshold

joint_reading.gate_A: the effect is incompatible with the registered paired-outcome null
joint_reading.gate_B: tests whether that effect appears spatially specific to the registered Gann lattice versus shifted-lattice placebo geometry
joint_reading.legitimate_outcome: Gate A very strong PASS with Gate B ordinary is a coherent result: a strong historical association exists, but the registered evidence does not support attributing it specifically to Gann geometry. That is a failure of the MECHANISM/SPECIFICITY claim, not of the inference engine.

rank_recovery.problem: the running exposure persists only the max-Z null's digest and summary stats (median, min, max, p95) — not the 999-element vector, and not p99 or the observed rank
computable_now: CASE 1 / 2 / 2B, all three decidable from max and p95 alone
rank_recovery.remedy: gate B is fully deterministic — every world seed is derived from the sealed chain. If the exact rank is wanted, gate B may be REPLAYED and the regenerated vector verified BIT-FOR-BIT against the sealed null_digest. A digest-matching replay recovers a diagnostic; it re-runs nothing and decides nothing.
rank_recovery.forbidden: using a replay as an opportunity to change any parameter

outcome_exposure: gate A exposed; gate B pending at seal time
